title: MS Capital张凯：超额收益不会消失，但懒人收益将退场
speaker: Kate Zhang

segments.en: I think AI does make quant strategies, quant trading is more powerful.
segments.zh: 我认为AI确实让量化策略和量化交易更强大。

segments.en: As AI itself isn't an alpha, but it's a tool.
segments.zh: 因为AI本身不是超额收益，而是一种工具。

segments.en: It depends on how you use it.
For example, we, I think we applied AI to our research platform quite early back to 2015.
segments.zh: 例如，我们早在2015年就将AI应用于我们的研究平台。

segments.en: And we do see the benefits from the result these days. Yeah.
segments.zh: 如今我们确实看到了成果带来的好处。是的。

segments.en: I mean, how do you look at the, there seems to be a bit of paradox, right?
segments.zh: 你怎么看，似乎有点矛盾，对吧？

segments.en: Because you look at how what analyst coverage is on some of these A share listed companies,
segments.zh: 因为你看一些内地上市公司的分析师覆盖情况，

segments.en: particularly when it comes to small caps, I think that's dwindled to just under 40% here right now.
segments.zh: 尤其是小盘股，我认为现在已经下降到略低于40%。

segments.en: But when you look at these bid-ass spreads, they're quite tight and quite tighter than most emerging markets out there here right now.
segments.zh: 但你看这些买卖价差，它们相当紧，比大多数新兴市场都要紧。

segments.en: How do you deal with that? And in some ways, do you think that it's a paradox in how you look at quant trading and quant strategies now? Yes.
segments.zh: 你如何应对？在某种程度上，你认为这是看待量化交易和量化策略的矛盾吗？是的。

segments.en: I think now people always ask, is there still alpha as it's getting crowded, there's alpha squeeze. Yes, there's still alpha, but the lazy alpha, the easy alpha is going to be retired.
segments.zh: 我认为现在人们总是问，随着市场变得拥挤，超额收益是否还存在，存在超额收益压缩。是的，仍然有超额收益，但懒惰的、容易的超额收益将退场。

segments.en: And it depends on where you look for it and how you define the alpha.
segments.zh: 这取决于你在哪里寻找以及如何定义超额收益。

segments.en: There's also always a new alpha because of the new policy, new environment.
segments.zh: 由于新政策、新环境，总会有新的超额收益。

segments.en: And you cannot rely on one factor, one strategy, one model.
segments.zh: 你不能依赖单一因子、单一策略、单一模型。

segments.en: So we train our system to adapt to the market and to the changes.
segments.zh: 所以我们训练我们的系统去适应市场和变化。
